input:
I have an IP-XACT 2022 file for a custom peripheral but it uses non-standard vendor extensions from our internal EDA tools. The file validates against schema but contains custom elements that aren't in the Accellera standard.

Relevant XML snippet:
```xml
<ipxact:component xmlns:ipxact="http://www.accellera.org/XMLSchema/IPXACT/1685-2022"
                  xmlns:vendor="http://internal.example.com/ipxact-ext">
  <ipxact:name>CustomDMAController</ipxact:name>
  <ipxact:memoryMaps>
    <ipxact:memoryMap>
      <ipxact:name>DMA_REGS</ipxact:name>
      <ipxact:addressBlock>
        <ipxact:name>ctrl_block</ipxact:name>
        <ipxact:baseAddress>0x0</ipxact:baseAddress>
        <ipxact:range>0x1000</ipxact:range>
        <ipxact:width>32</ipxact:width>
        <ipxact:register>
          <ipxact:name>DMA_CTRL</ipxact:name>
          <ipxact:addressOffset>0x0</ipxact:addressOffset>
          <ipxact:size>32</ipxact:size>
          <vendor:powerDomain>PD_DMA</vendor:powerDomain>
          <vendor:clockGating>CLK_DMA_AXI</vendor:clockGating>
          <vendor:securityLevel>NS</vendor:securityLevel>
        </ipxact:register>
      </ipxact:addressBlock>
    </ipxact:memoryMap>
  </ipxact:memoryMaps>
  <vendor:customConstraints>
    <vendor:maxBurstLength>16</vendor:maxBurstLength>
    <vendor:axiProtocol>AXI4</vendor:axiProtocol>
  </vendor:customConstraints>
</ipxact:component>
```

Can the extractor handle the vendor:* extensions, or will it silently drop them? How should we handle the power domain and clock gating annotations that aren't standard IP-XACT?
